question: 2026년 2학기 소프트웨어융합학과 데이터사이언스및시각화(SWCON425-00) 교수님께 수요일에 가려고 해. 개설목록에 수요일 정규수업이 있는지 1 또는 0으로, 강의계획서의 면담 안내는 그대로 알려줘.

WITH target AS (
    SELECT o.offering_id
    FROM course_offerings AS o
    WHERE o.year = 2026
      AND o.semester = '2'
      AND o.course_code = 'SWCON425'
      AND o.section = '00'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM course_offering_categories AS coc
          JOIN departments AS d ON d.department_id = coc.department_id
          WHERE coc.offering_id = o.offering_id
            AND d.name = '소프트웨어융합학과'
      )
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM target AS t
           JOIN course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = t.offering_id
           JOIN class_times AS ct ON ct.offering_id = t.offering_id
           JOIN time_slots AS ts ON ts.time_slot_id = ct.time_slot_id
           WHERE o.schedule_status = 'SCHEDULED'
             AND ts.day = 'wednesday'
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_wednesday_regular_class,
       s.consultation_time
FROM target AS t
LEFT JOIN syllabi AS s ON s.offering_id = t.offering_id;
